Thank you for the information. I see you're a child with frequent nosebleeds, bleeding from the gums or other mucous membranes, and a rash of small red spots (petechiae). Have you noticed if the bleeding stops easily or if you bruise very easily from minor bumps?

REQUEST TEST: Platelet count, PT (Prothrombin Time), and aPTT (activated Partial Thromboplastin Time).

text: RESULTS: Platelets: 280,000 /μL (normal); PT: 12 seconds (normal); aPTT: 30 seconds (normal)

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Frequent epistaxis. I also have Mucous membrane bleeding, Diffuse petechiae on distal extremities.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical issues. Up-to-date on vaccinations. Social history: Attends preschool. Lives with parents and one older sibling.
